name: verify_step
description: Submit a single reasoning or mathematical step to the tamper-evident SHA-256 session ledger before stating it. Supported step kinds: 'compute' {expr, value}, 'solve' {equation, claimed: {x: val}}, 'reasoning' {text}, 'interpretation' {text}.

session.description: Session identifier for the multi-step reasoning chain.

step.description: Step object containing 'kind' and kind-specific parameters.
